svg.title: Noise on one puzzle versus the average
svg.desc: Each dot is one puzzle. Running the same configuration twice on dev gives per-puzzle differences spread across the scale, but the mean difference is +0.4 points (95% CI -4.9 to 5.8). Bare versus final on test gives a mean difference of +22.1 (95% CI 17.5 to 26.5).
